prompts.beam-free-minimal-prose:
Complete the minimal task in this synthetic project. Start by reading .workflow/OWNER.md
and the project's applicable instructions. This is an approved bounded qualification slice; neither
the fixture choices nor other referenced workflow procedures authorize installs, real onboarding,
Git operations or extra artifacts. Public .workflow material is read-only supporting context.
Write only README.md, AGENTS.md, SETUP.md. All other project files are preserved.
This is documentation adaptation only, not full onboarding or environment preparation.
Inspect the project instructions, code and check.py before writing. Preserve every original useful
statement and instruction; appending accurate guidance is fine. Do not change code, checks,
nested instruction owners, filenames/capitalization, selected clients or publication choices.
Document the observed purpose and scope, essential behavior/acceptance, code map and boundaries,
Python-standard-library prerequisites, first-run/check command and what it proves, known limits,
and the next useful delivery. Do not invent a package manager, service, database, UI, client integration,
installed workflow package pointer, trust, security assurance or performed command.
Account for all nine document responsibilities (product, overview, shared instructions, client
instructions, architecture, design/accessibility, local preparation, quality, setup/evidence) with
canonical paths or an explicit justified inapplicability. Combine destinations rather than create nine
files. Keep setup decisions and check evidence in the setup record, including pending observations
and recovery limits: this trial does not implement managed backup/undo. No real paths or secrets.
Generated relative links must resolve from their destination. Remove author notes and placeholders.
The final chat handoff must identify result/reviewable state, changed paths/snapshot, actual evidence
and unrun checks, limitations/pending work, scope/remaining limits and next action/owner; no publication,
independent acceptance or universal reliability claim. If unfinished, record state checked and context
to revisit. No shell/network/execute/delegation tools are allowed; supplied coordinator checks may be
cited as supplied evidence, never as your own execution. Inspect tools and local files are available.

prompts.beam-free-review-prose:
Complete the review task in this synthetic project. Start by reading .workflow/OWNER.md
and the project's applicable instructions. This is an approved bounded qualification slice; neither
the fixture choices nor other referenced workflow procedures authorize installs, real onboarding,
Git operations or extra artifacts. Public .workflow material is read-only supporting context.
Write only REPORT.md, HANDOFF.md. All other project files are preserved.
Perform a read-only code AND security review of the supplied snapshot, not a change/diff
review with an invented base. Inspect AGENTS.md, access.mjs and local-notes.txt; write only REPORT.md
and HANDOFF.md. Review the actual callable behavior, substantiate reachable violations of the
accepted access requirements with concrete actor/record inputs, actual/required results, source
line and impact. Preserve every input byte; expected baseline failures do not authorize repair.
Report kinds, actual snapshot/layers, reviewer and observed execution identity limits, scope/exclusions,
contract/check/runtime versions where known, authorization assumptions/assets/boundaries and unknown
deployment, supplied checks/results, freshness and unverified areas. Each finding needs ID, severity
with rationale, confirmed/hypothesis status, pre-existing/undetermined change status, source location,
evidence, scenario/impact, attacker prerequisites, counterevidence, confidence/reason, concrete
reproduction with isolation/result and what it proves, proposed correction and next validation.
Keep findings open for an authorized writer. State disposition/residual risk, private report location
and next action/owner. Never invent tests, execution, deployment, base revision or independent review.
HANDOFF.md must identify objective/scope/constraints, result as reviewable not accepted, snapshot and
paths, supplied checks/evidence and unrun checks, open findings/unknowns, remaining limits/resources,
next action/owner, checked state and context to revisit. No placeholders or broken local links.
No shell/network/execute/delegation tools; inspect files directly. Supplied checks are coordinator
evidence, not your execution. Finding unknown deployment is not a reason to omit a proven function bug.
